title: Restaurant ordering software
summary: Online ordering software for independent restaurants.
whyItFails: Restaurants struggle. Low budgets. Platform competition. Delivery apps add tools. Sales cost. High acquisition costs.

attempts.outcome: Still operating; laid off staff in 2024
attempts.notes: Commission-free ordering for restaurants on a monthly subscription.

attempts.outcome: US business sold to UrbanPiper after its parent cut staff

reasons.detail: Platform competition: Delivery apps add tools.
